statement: I feel a strong duty to fix what's wrong and hold myself to high moral standards.
I feel valued when I'm needed by others and often put their needs above my own.
I strive to succeed and want to be seen as capable and accomplished.
I often feel different from others and want to be seen as unique and authentic.
I prefer solitude to recharge and enjoy analyzing ideas deeply and independently.
I seek security through loyalty and often worry about what could go wrong.
I chase exciting experiences and avoid feeling trapped in boredom or emotional pain.
I assert myself to stay in control and protect myself and others from being vulnerable.
I avoid conflict by going along with others, even at the cost of my own preferences.
